name: Vetame21-skills
description: Application and academic writing skills by Vetame21

plugins.name: debate-mode
plugins.description: Evidence-first debate. Instead of agreeing, Claude researches a claim or proposal and returns a sourced verdict (Yes / No / Partly / Not enough evidence) before giving a recommendation. Use when the user asks Claude to debate, argue, challenge them, push back, fact-check, "debat pakai fakta", "jangan iya-iya aja", "don't just agree", "prove it", or asks whether an idea, claim, or edit (for example to a personal statement or CV) is right or relevant.

plugins.name: harvard-cv
plugins.description: Create, upgrade, or tailor a CV/resume in the Harvard style (one page, reverse chronological, Education → Experience → Leadership & Activities → Skills & Interests, action-verb bullets with results). Use when the user asks to make, fix, review, upgrade, or tailor a CV or resume, mentions "Harvard CV", "Harvard resume", "Harvard format", or needs a CV to go with a university, scholarship, internship, or job application.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Make any piece of writing sound natural and like its author instead of machine-written - personal statements, reports, thesis chapters, CVs, cover letters, emails, posts - in English or Indonesian. Diagnoses AI-sounding words, rhythm and structure, asks whether to also upgrade the content, then rewrites at the lightest touch while keeping every fact, number and citation. Use when the user says humanize, humanizer, make it sound human or natural, sounds like AI, kayak AI, kurang natural, terlalu kaku, pastes an AI-detector report (GPTZero, Turnitin, ZeroGPT), or runs /humanizer.

plugins.name: personal-statement
plugins.description: Write, upgrade and stress-test personal statements, statements of purpose, motivation letters, scholarship essays, short-answer application questions and self-introductions, for school leavers, graduate and PhD applicants, scholarships and jobs. Keeps the applicant's own story and voice, checks every fact, debates content choices before and after drafting, and prepares interview or video answers. Use when the user shares a statement to improve, wants one written from their material, asks if something belongs in it, wants current facts added, or needs interview prep from it.

plugins.name: report
plugins.description: Plan, write, review and polish academic and technical reports - lab reports (laporan praktikum), programming lab and assignment reports, technical/project reports, makalah, internship reports (laporan magang / kerja praktik / KP), and research or progress reports - in Indonesian or English. Use when the user asks to write, structure, fix, shorten, or review a report, mentions laporan, lab report, praktikum, makalah, KP, magang, project report, or wants a report checked for structure, citations, or AI-sounding language.

plugins.name: thesis
plugins.description: Coach a student through an undergraduate thesis (skripsi, tugas akhir, bachelor's thesis, graduation project / 毕业论文), from choosing a topic, writing the proposal, structuring chapters (Indonesian Bab I-V or international IMRaD), literature review, methodology, results and discussion, citations, similarity and AI-use rules, and preparing for the defense (sidang). Use when the user mentions skripsi, tugas akhir, TA, thesis, proposal penelitian, seminar proposal, sidang, bab 1/2/3/4/5, latar belakang, rumusan masalah, tinjauan pustaka, metodologi, or wants a thesis chapter reviewed, debated, or improved.
